At Commonwealth Dentistry in Chester, our dedicated endodontic and periodontal specialists are here to provide specialized dental care for you and your family. We focus on offering care tailored to the unique needs of each patient. Above all, our priority is always your long-term health and well-being.
Our specialty Chester endodontic and periodontal office is located right next to our Chester general dentist office.
With our conveniently located office and friendly, welcoming staff, scheduling appointments has never been easier.
We pride ourselves on providing an experience centered around you. Our appointments always begin promptly and aim to exceed your expectations.
We accept most major insurance plans along with many regional ones. For those without insurance, our in-house discount plan offers great benefits.
Our Chester endodontist and periodontist are trained and experienced in providing the latest specialty treatments comfortably and effectively.

Our periodontic services focus on the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of periodontal disease, as well as the placement of dental implants. We offer advanced treatments such as gum grafting, bone grafting, and dental implants to address tooth loss and gum recession.

Our periodontist works closely with patients to develop personalized treatment plans, ensuring the best possible care for those with periodontal needs, with a focus on restoring oral health and aesthetics.

Commonwealth Dentistry’s endodontic services are focused on diagnosing and treating tooth pain and performing root canal treatments to save teeth with diseased or injured pulp. Our skilled endodontist uses state-of-the-art technology to ensure precise and comfortable procedures.

Our team is committed to relieving tooth pain and preserving natural teeth, highlighting the importance of maintaining dental health and function. Through our expert care, patients can expect an emphasis on pain management, restoration, and prevention of future dental issues.

At Commonwealth Dentistry, our oral surgery services address a wide range of complex dental issues. Whether you need wisdom teeth extractions, dental implants, or jaw surgery, our experienced oral surgeon uses advanced technology to ensure precise, comfortable care.
We’re focused on improving both your oral health and quality of life. Expect a seamless experience that emphasizes quick recovery and minimal discomfort.

Our in-house periodontist, Dr. Nicholas Yesbeck, is a lifelong Richmonder. He grew up in Midlothian and attended Virginia Commonwealth University for 11 years, where he received his undergraduate degree, DDS degree, and specialty certificate in periodontics with a Master of Science in Dentistry. He currently serves as an Affiliate Faculty Member with Virginia Commonwealth University’s Department of Periodontics. His training was concentrated on treating periodontal disease, gum grafting, bone grafting, dental implants, and moderate sedation.

He is a member of the American Academy of Periodontology, the American Dental Association, the Virginia Dental Association, and the Richmond Dental Society. He also gives back to the community through local Mission of Mercy projects in Virginia.
Outside of dentistry, he enjoys spending time with his family and staying active outdoors.

Bilal Khan, BDS, CAGS Endodontics, brings a wealth of experience and advanced training to our practice. Originally from Karachi, Pakistan, he completed dental school at Dow University of Health Sciences and furthered his expertise with an AEGD program at the University of Connecticut School of Dental Medicine. He then pursued advanced endodontic training at Boston University Henry M. Goldman School of Dental Medicine.

Dr. Khan is dedicated to providing efficient, high-quality endodontic care with a focus on patient comfort and collaboration. His warm approach ensures patients feel at ease and fully informed throughout their treatment. His skills include surgical and non-surgical root canal treatments, molar and non-molar root canals, retreatments, and apicoectomies. Dr. Khan is passionate about alleviating his patients’ pain and saving their teeth.

Outside of dentistry, Dr. Khan enjoys outdoor activities, hiking, and family game nights with his wife and daughter. He has a keen interest in music, shoes, and watches, appreciating the craftsmanship of quality timepieces.
